description: CodeSafe is an open-source Python library for code encryption, decryption, and safe evaluation using Python's AST module. From versions 0.0.1 through 0.0.4, the safe_eval() function can be bypassed with indirect subscript calls such as builtins'exec', because AST validation blocks only direct calls to dangerous built-ins. An attacker who controls an expression passed to safe_eval() can execute arbitrary Python code with the permissions of the host application. This issue is fixed in version 0.0.5.
